responsibility: Provides rustc’s arena-allocation support so compiler data structures can be created cheaply with shared arena lifetimes instead of per-object deallocation. The crate root (`src/lib.rs`) defines the core arena infrastructure: typed and dropless bump allocators, chunk growth and destruction behavior, and the `declare_arena!` macro plus related allocation traits used by compiler crates to build crate-specific `Arena` types for efficient storage of compiler data. Its internal test module (`src/tests.rs`) validates this responsibility by testing allocation and reuse behavior across copy, non-copy, zero-sized, nested, and droppable values, including a test-only clear path and checks that clearing and dropping arenas run destructors correctly and preserve expected performance-oriented behavior.
